subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Man of straw

options.text: A combination of two people that is perfect in every way
A child of a celebrity or a famous person
A person who is disregarded as lacking character or morality
A situation like a close contest

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Man of straw"** refers to: • A person who is disregarded as lacking character or morality. (चरित्र या नैतिकता की कमी के कारण उपेक्षित व्यक्ति) • **Example:** He was considered a **man of straw** because he never stood up for what he believed in. • The correct word **"Man of straw"** means: • A person who is weak and lacks substance, often used to describe someone without real power or influence. (कमजोर और महत्वहीन व्यक्ति) • **Example:** Despite his loud claims, everyone knew he was just a man of straw with no real influence. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** A combination of two people that is perfect in every way. (दो लोगों का ऐसा संयोजन जो हर तरह से परिपूर्ण हो) • **Example:** They are often seen as the ideal couple, a combination of two people that is perfect in every way. • **Option 2:** A child of a celebrity or a famous person. (किसी प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति का बच्चा) • **Example:** Being a child of a celebrity, she was always in the limelight. • **Option 4:** A situation like a close contest. (एक करीबी प्रतियोगिता जैसी स्थिति) • **Example:** The match was a close contest, with both teams giving their best. 37:Tc42, The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
